what each rank opens
The New Workings of every mine: the Deep Workings, the Deepdelve, and the mine of every world that has one
Press E at a face or a seam and stay. A load comes off about once a minute; a pickaxe of your own is quicker
Shared by everyone: rich, fair, thin, worked out. A worked-out vein comes back a load in ten minutes
More ore in a load, and rough gems more often (quartz near the top, ruby in the deepest seams)
What you hew goes in your cart. Push it back to the way back and it goes up the cage into your Backpack
Past the first gallery the roof creaks: set a prop (press E), or it comes in and shuts that face for 15 minutes. Anyone may set a prop for a crewmate
In the deepest seams your lamp may burn low: walk back towards the shaft within a minute, or the crew carries you up and half your cart is spilt
Hewing while clocked in as a miner digs your mine further too
Nobody is ever hurt in the mines: the worst is a shut face or a lighter cart.
Rare materials are only ever found, never sold.
The working face is open to everyone. The seams past the first gallery need a Hewer; the deep seams and the stope a Face-hand; the deepest seams and the great cavern a Deputy.
The rock here is shot through with ore: today it gives three times as much.
